description: The file defines an Android activity named Clipping that demonstrates different clipping operations on a Canvas, including rect and path clipping.

classes.name: Clipping
classes.description: An Android activity subclass that initializes and sets a custom View for demonstrating canvas clipping.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that implements various canvas clipping techniques within its onDraw method.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Clipping activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: SampleView (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the custom view, sets up paint object and path for drawing.

methods.name: drawScene
methods.description: Draws a scene with colored shapes and text, used multiple times with different clip settings.
